text:
Type: wide metal shelving unit with drawers
Use: storing books, files, clothes and decor, open storage wall; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: industrial, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: white powder-coated steel frame and shelves, white metal drawers
Colors: white
Shape: two tall open bays side by side, slim perforated uprights, shelves on several levels, a band of four wide flat-front drawers at mid-height, open back, large but light and airy
Feel: clean, airy, orderly, practical
Goes with: light wood, concrete floors, plants, black or wood accents; industrial, minimalist or Scandinavian lofts and studios

product.name: FJLKINGE
product.description: The long, slender shelves give the shelving unit a light and airy look. And the clean, simple lines make it easy to combine with many styles of furniture.
